occupancy.label: Occupancy / regime
occupancy.hint: Regime follows occupancy, not county. VA-leased is ISC.

options.label: DoD UFC 4-010-01 Jul 2 2026 digital
floorChecks: Confirm UFC 4-010-01 dated Jul 2 2026 on T-001 or Division 01. Price that stamp.
Glazing floor is §5-11, not cancelled C3 Standard 10.
Commentary: minimize hazardous fragments. Not designed for blast resistance.
Glass floor: min 1/4 in laminated or polycarbonate, or two 1/8 in plies + 0.030 in PVB. Cite §5-11.1.
IGU: laminate or PC inboard. No monolithic inner lite.
Silicone bite = larger of 3/8 in or glass thickness. Bead min 3/16 in. Cite §5-11.1.
Tape bite = 2× laminated-glass thickness. Not 2× the silicone bite. Cite §5-11.1.
Bite on both sides of a single pane. Inboard lite only on an IGU. Cite §5-11.1.
Polycarbonate bite ≥ 1.5× PC thickness.
Vestibules and stairs are in §5-11.2. Doors are §5-12.1.
Replacement on an inhabited DoD building still triggers §5-11 under §5-1.1.2.1. Not the 50% renovation trigger.
Film is not a UFC alternate. §5-11.4.
2018 Appendix B B-3.1 is deleted. Do not price it.
ASTM F1642 / F2912 / F2248 only if the spec cites them.
Florida impact often laminates outboard. UFC laminates inboard. Check the makeup.
Do not invent psi or standoff. Those are not on the §5-11 floor.
Sources: https://www.wbdg.org/dod/ufc/ufc-4-010-01 and digital.wbdg.org criteria 232da0b3-da5b-430e-aaaf-232c4e98d202/latest

options.label: GSA / ISC leased off-post
options.detail: UFC 5-1.2.7.6 sends leased not-on-DoD to ISC. VA-leased is also ISC.
floorChecks: UFC 5-1.2.7.6 sends leased space that is not on a DoD installation to ISC.
Use ISC RMP 2024. Do not copy UFC §5-11 numbers onto an ISC job.
GSA P100 was rescinded Feb 24 2025. PBS Interim Core Building Standards still cite ISC.
Public glazing LOP tables are FOUO. Print TBD. Do not print psi.
VA-leased space is ISC, not VA-owned PSRDM.
Still run the Florida wind path in parallel. An NOA is not a blast rating.
Do not copy DoD UFGS 08 56 53 onto this job.

options.label: VA-owned PSRDM
options.detail: VA Physical Security and Resiliency Design Manual. Not UFC.
floorChecks: VA Physical Security and Resiliency Design Manual, Oct 1 2020, rev May 1 2024. Not UFC.
Designations are Critical / Essential / Ancillary. Not the old Life Safety / Mission Critical labels.
Standoff Table 3-1: Essential/Ancillary 25 ft, Critical 50 ft, screened 5 ft.
New glass: laminated inner lite.
Bite 1/2 in plus 3/8 in structural silicone on the inner lite. §6.3.1.2.
Table 6-3: Essential/Ancillary fragments ≤ 10 ft into the room. Critical may crack but stay in frame.
Table 6-1 GP psi: TBD. Do not invent a GP magnitude.
If glazing is not replaced, §6.3.2.1 allows 7-mil film with demonstrated performance. VA existing-glass only. Not a UFC substitute.
VA 08 56 53 live URL: TBD. DoD UFGS 08 56 53 is not VA.
VA-leased is ISC. This path is VA-owned only.
Do not copy UFC §5-11 numbers onto a VA job.
Still run the Florida wind path in parallel.
Source: https://www.cfm.va.gov/til/PhysicalSecurity/dmPhySec.pdf

floridaWind.label: Florida wind path
floridaWind.hint: Palm Beach and Monroe are not HVHZ. NOA is accepted statewide. FL# is not enough in HVHZ.

options.label: HVHZ Miami-Dade + Broward NOA (TAS 201/202/203)
options.detail: HVHZ is Miami-Dade and Broward only.
floorChecks: HVHZ is Miami-Dade and Broward only. Palm Beach and Monroe are not HVHZ.
Current Miami-Dade NOA tested to TAS 201 / 202 / 203.
Verify the NOA live at permit and again at installation. Configuration-specific.
FL# is not enough in HVHZ. NOA is accepted statewide; the reverse is not true.
9th Edition manufacturer affirmation if the permit application is on or after Dec 31 2026.
FBC 9th Edition effective Dec 31 2026. Fla. Stat. 553.73(6) and 553.73(7)(d): permit-application date governs.
Dec 30 application stays 8th Edition. Dec 31 and later is 9th Edition.
ASCE 7-22 is already in the 8th Edition. December 31 is not a wind-code switch.
Do not spec 9th Edition U-factor or SHGC. Those cells are TBD.
9th Edition TAS cell deltas are TBD. Do not invent them.
Florida impact often laminates outboard. Check that makeup against the federal overlay.

options.label: Rest-of-Florida FPA
options.detail: Current FL# or NOA. NOA is accepted statewide.
floorChecks: Rest of Florida: current FL# or a Miami-Dade NOA. NOA is accepted statewide.
Palm Beach and Monroe are not HVHZ. Do not demand an NOA as if they were.
FL# is not enough if this opening is actually in Miami-Dade or Broward. Recheck the county.
9th Edition manufacturer affirmation if the permit application is on or after Dec 31 2026.
FBC 9th Edition effective Dec 31 2026. Fla. Stat. 553.73(6) and 553.73(7)(d): permit-application date governs.
Dec 30 application stays 8th Edition. Dec 31 and later is 9th Edition.
ASCE 7-22 is already in the 8th Edition. December 31 is not a wind-code switch.
Do not spec 9th Edition U-factor or SHGC. Those cells are TBD.
Florida impact often laminates outboard. Check that makeup against the federal overlay.

overlay.label: Federal overlay
overlay.hint: A Miami-Dade NOA is not a blast rating.

options.label: §5-11 floor only
options.detail: Price the floor. Do not add ASTM unless the spec names it.
floorChecks: Price the §5-11 floor only. Do not add ASTM F1642 / F2912 / F2248 unless the spec names them.
Dual-path Florida wind approval is still required.
A Miami-Dade NOA is wind and impact. It is not a blast rating.

options.label: Spec cites F1642 / F2912 / F2248
options.detail: Above the floor. Do not invent hazard levels.
floorChecks: The spec cites ASTM F1642 / F2912 / F2248. That is above the §5-11 floor.
Do not invent hazard levels, psi, or standoff.
Florida NOA or FPA is still required. The NOA is not the ASTM overlay.
Check inboard vs outboard laminate. Florida impact often laminates outboard. UFC and VA laminate inboard.

options.label: GC treating NOA as blast
options.stopBody: A Miami-Dade NOA is wind and impact, not blast. You still need (1) NOA or FPA, (2) the occupancy-regime glass and bite, and (3) ASTM only if the spec cites it. Check inboard vs outboard laminate before you price.
options.detail: STOP. An NOA is not a blast rating.
floorChecks: STOP. An NOA is wind and impact, not blast.
Need (1) NOA or FPA, (2) occupancy-regime glass and bite, (3) ASTM only if cited.
Check inboard vs outboard laminate. Florida impact often laminates outboard. UFC and VA laminate inboard.
Do not copy UFC numbers onto a VA or ISC job. Do not copy DoD UFGS 08 56 53 onto VA.
